# harmoniq_remote_module (Resource)

A remote module (micro frontend) of a host app. Versions are deployed by CI, not Terraform. Deleting is refused while the module has an active or canary version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harmoniq_remote_module" "checkout" {
  workspace   = harmoniq_workspace.checkout_team.slug
  host_app    = harmoniq_host_app.storefront.slug
  slug        = "checkout"
  name        = "Checkout"
  description = "Cart and payment"
  specifier   = "@acme/checkout"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_app` (String) Host app slug.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Module slug; its name in manifests.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace slug.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `specifier` (String) Import-map specifier, e.g. `@acme/checkout` (defaults to the slug).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Module id (use it for API key `module_ids` and alert rules).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Module id (or slug) after the workspace slug.
terraform import harmoniq_remote_module.checkout checkout-team/checkout
```
